statement.text:
(J. Wiegold). Let Γ be a finite simple group and let Nn (Γ) denote the set of
normal subgroups of the free group Fn of rank n whose quotient is isomorphic to Γ.
   Conjecture: Aut(Fn ) acts transitively on Nn (Γ) for n ⩾ 3.
   This is not true for n = 2 (B. H. Neumann, H. Neumann, Math. Nachr., 4 (1951),
106–125).                                                              A. Lubotzky
